description: This file contains a PHP trait 'HTMLUtils' providing utility methods for directory management and copying theme files, specifically designed for HTML format handling within the Daux documentation generator project.

methods.name: ensureEmptyDestination
methods.description: Ensures that the specified destination is empty by removing it if it exists as a directory, or creating it if it does not exist.

methods.name: copyThemes
methods.description: Copies theme files from a local source directory to a destination directory, creating a 'themes' folder in the destination.
